scope: Analysis first, after actual build197 terminal verification. Existing counters and already saved query traces only; no new profiler, baseline run or repair decision change.

query_identity_assessment.exact_hits: BoundPhysicalSurface memo uses authority-owned cache, complete ordered support, tolerance and exact physical coordinates. FaceMemo includes bindings and versions. Existing keys must remain exact.
query_identity_assessment.misses: Cannot separate novel or nearby positions, changed support/tolerance and evicted identical queries from aggregate counters. Evictions are observed, not proof that every miss is novel.
query_identity_assessment.saved_payload: Existing older168 payload has six same-face/same-support pairs with changed coordinates. It is not a representative sample of build197 misses or blocked stars.

existing_support_review.unchanged_faces: HasAcceptedFaceCertificate and ExportParameters check exact accepted face, binding/point and trace overrides; boundary_replacement_ready reuses unchanged complete face contracts. Association/coverage certificate is not a numerical distance bound.
existing_support_review.changed_faces: Unchanged accepted association checks can be skipped. Exact numerical face/union memo can reuse identical queries. Changed-face-only work cannot replace a complete final two-sided union check or establish absence of holes.
existing_support_review.prepared_geometry: Existing prepared facet pools, exact scope pools, reusable SurfaceForest/witness subtrees and spatial candidates are starting points. No new whole-union-copy mechanism selected.
existing_support_review.smoothing: Existing star/support/old merit/projected context, lazy old-side guidance, shape/validity/height/edge screening, and safe partial nonnegative geometry rejection remain in place. Fresh position-dependent metric and private geometry evaluations remain necessary.
existing_support_review.early_bounds: Existing outward interval plane/witness bounds, finite hole-aware footprints and full fallback. Build196 witness-first savings are retained; no duplicate envelope justified.

smoothing_limit: Private accepted moves/debt gain do not measure published whole-field q/J improvement; costs overlap with upper/traversal service.

remaining_tolerance_assessment.mathematical_condition: For corresponding affine physical triangles and identical immutable target/support, a proven one-sided upper U plus an outward-rounded maximum corresponding vertex displacement D bounds the new one-sided distance. Uncertain support/correspondence/rounding falls back.
remaining_tolerance_assessment.limits: This one-sided bound does not by itself certify reverse coverage, associations, genuine features, body separation or requested heights. Sampling is insufficient.
remaining_tolerance_assessment.existing_measured_evidence: Previously preserved exact-rational motion analysis certifies 0 of12 saved whole queries. Optimistic subtree bound saves at most810/140510 counted work (0.5765%) before lookup/storage/invalidation. Not a measured build197 speedup.
remaining_tolerance_assessment.decision: No motion/slack cache or new envelope implementation justified.

saved_trace_attribution.limits: Older12query corpus, not build197 cache miss population. No new trace campaign.
saved_trace_attribution.backlog_only: Existing nominal triangle coverage order, finer preparation and new envelope/index alternatives remain unproven. Must measure hard/easy saved-query regressions before choosing implementation.

next_target: Speed of net whole-field quality closure in this attempt, while retaining the active197 boundary repair-power/geometry continuation. Its new return branch was never reached, so it is unqualified on M6, not disproved. No competing implementation selected by this analysis.
acceptance: All geometry/association/feature/body/height and final quality/size gates unchanged; exact invalidation, memory admission, reference lifetime and fail-closed exhaustion mandatory. CAD optional. Two accepted meshes, transfer, finite adapted CFD, disk restart, BL/MPI and RANS500k remain outstanding.
